input.description: Find where FileServerService is wired up

content.text:
I have the full chain traced from route registration through to the SQL data layer.

h07.

- `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` route registration — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124` (registered from `server/server.go:82`)
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` (handler) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `store.Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `store.Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `driver.ListUsers` (interface dispatch) via `s.driver` field, driver set in `store/store.go`
- `sqlite.DB.ListUsers` (concrete SQL query against `user` table) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (equivalent implementations exist in `store/db/postgres/user.go` and `store/db/mysql/user.go` depending on configured driver)

Note: `serveUserAvatar` reads the returned `user.AvatarURL` (a base64 data URI stored directly on the `user` row, decoded via `parseDataURI` at `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737`) rather than fetching a separate attachment/blob — so the "stored data" for a profile image is the `user.avatar_url` column itself.
